source: SSFD v3; data/raw/manifest.json; existing experiments/hi_v1/protocol.json for the exact outer and inner groups, baseline features, seeds and perturbations
population: 480 nonoverlapping 3200x3 windows; all 16 occurrence IDs and all 48 files; S=1, E/B=0 inherited per file; time of decision=end_s

configurations.H: original 36 features / existing standardized RBF SVC
configurations.R: robust 36 features / same RF as A1
configurations.J: same I SVC, append 3x64 median-centered log subband powers; preserve original robust 36 features
configurations.K: same J representation and SVC, componentwise median across current and up to 3 preceding vectors in the same file

fine_spectrum: Welch fs=6400, Hann, nperseg=1024, noverlap=512, constant detrend, median average, density; bins 1..512, 8 per band (50 Hz); 64 bands per axis; ln(max(sum PSD * 6.25, 1e-12)), subtract median over 64 log bands per axis; order x,y,z then increasing frequency

hypotheses.J: Training-group high-band log spectral profiles show positive and negative S-minus-nonS differences inside the last broad band. Preserve within-band structure. Compare J vs I for inner/outer recall and FP at fixed budgets.
hypotheses.K: In every training split within-file deviations are smaller than between-file deviations. A trailing median may reduce short noise but can erase informative changes. Compare K vs J on the same 480 endpoints in every condition.

history: no padding or warm-up exclusion; reset between files and at invalid input; every prior endpoint uses the same tested scenario and training-only scale
threshold: only clean 3-fold grouped inner OOF scores; maximize TP subject to floor(budget*N_nonS); ties minimize FP then highest cutoff; score >= cutoff
selection: choose within each outer training split separately for each budget, greatest inner TP then fewest FP then models_in_tie_order; freeze before scoring the outer test data. Full-data model repeats group 3-fold selection on all 16 groups with deployment budget 0.15
adopt: require primary nested selection to meet both targets on clean and all four perturbations and at least as many clean TP and no more FP than A1 at 15%, with one strict improvement; otherwise retain A0 default
waveform: no smoothing, clipping, repair, waveform normalization, training augmentation or abstention; fixed v4 perturbations only in evaluation
metrics: same held-out windows paired to A1 and I at the same budget; rates from counts; AUC and AP per outer fold with unweighted means across four folds
